svg.text: Every transformation between the WordPress editor and the reader's screen

g.text: Strip XML artifacts, MS Word classes (p1, s1, MsoNormal)
Strip span styles, unwrap [go-deeper] from wrapper tags, remove contenteditable
Add poster=".jpg" and <source> to [video mp4] shortcodes
Wrap tables in div.table-responsive, add Bootstrap classes
http://s3, src="http:, src="//" all forced to https
Strip inline color: #hex; styles (breaks dark mode)
Rewrite local media URLs to S3/CloudFront (runs last)
Content is stored to DB with all filters already applied. But the V4 read API applies the_content filters
The autolinker and story indexer also run again on read. These filters are not fully idempotent.
Key HTML classes and structures in the output
ath_autolink go-deeper table-responsive wp-video twitter-tweet showcase-link-container
V3 API (older mobile path) reads from custom posts table directly and does NOT re-apply filters. Only V4 double-filters.
PHP returns a single article_body field. Apollo generates desktop/mobile variants itself.
GraphQL middleware: parsing, ads, modules, theme
HTML string parsed via JSDOM into typed blocks:
VideoEmbed, Inline. Char count per block.
1. data-theme="dark" on Twitter blockquotes (if dark mode)
2. theme=auto param on Apple Podcast iframes
Blocks joined to HTML string. Cached per variant:
desktop/mobile x dark/light x experiment options
Position IDs: mid1, mid2, mid3... + sponsor slot
2. Adequate characters since last ad (300 first, 1800 between)
4. Next block is Paragraph, Header, or HorizontalRule
5. Next block not special text: "Grade", "Rating", "Up next", etc.
7. Not the last block in the article
Desktop: 4/5/7 para gaps | Mobile: 3 para gaps | First ad: 300+ chars
Client-side transforms before render. Also serves mobile webviews.
Client breakpoint picks desktop or mobile
String-replaces CSS classes on ad containers.
sponsor alignment. Does NOT insert slots.
useLayoutEffect queries DOM, mounts via createPortal:
Ad mediator fills .ad.place-ad divs from step 3.3
Same pipeline, but suppresses analytics, paywalls, and suggested follows.
Native apps detect via isTAAppUserAgent(). Ad targeting provided by native window.AdBridge.
Fetches the full rendered HTML page
Extracts + caches images, CSS, JS, fonts from HTML
Mobile apps load the full web page in a webview. If the web frontend renders correctly, mobile is correct too.
Mobile-specific concerns are limited to: ?embed=1 code path, native bridges (window.native, window.AdBridge), and asset caching.
Not in the article body HTML (separate fields/queries)
